proposed_comments.title: Preserve healthy details when a non-observable refresh fails
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve healthy details when a non-observable refresh fails

**Severity:** `high`

When a reused non-observable details model is refreshed, a snapshot getter exception currently propagates through `SafeSlowInit` and cleans up the entire otherwise-healthy list item. A transient failure while reading one details property can therefore replace valid details with an error state and discard the previously usable graph. Refresh into a replacement `DetailsViewModel`, clean up only that replacement on failure, report the exception, and keep the existing details and item state intact; add a regression test for a failed refresh after successful initialization.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The safe correction must coordinate DetailsViewModel replacement, ListItemViewModel error handling, cleanup ownership, and regression coverage; no single current RIGHT-side range can express the complete behavior safely.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The safe correction must coordinate DetailsViewModel replacement, ListItemViewModel error handling, cleanup ownership, and regression coverage; no single current RIGHT-side range can express the complete behavior safely.

confidence.rationale: The live upstream path directly reuses the existing details graph and lets snapshot exceptions reach item-level cleanup; the converged review tree contains focused replacement-state and failure-preservation coverage for this exact path.

proposed_comments.title: Guard selection publication and completion against stale lifetime work
proposed_comments.body:
### Guard selection publication and completion against stale lifetime work

**Severity:** `high`

The current selection flow checks cancellation and selection state before scheduling UI work, but an obsolete callback can still run after a newer selection publishes its details or hide message. In addition, completion can be signaled before queued lifetime notifications and a selection action behind an active initialization have drained, allowing stale details or suggestions to win the race or causing a real queued selection to be reported as failed. Keep a generation check at the actual UI publication point, read the current details inside that callback, and enqueue completion after the lifetime action and its notifications; add regression coverage for rapid reselection, queued initialization, and cleanup/failure.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The fix spans ListViewModel generation tracking, UI-scheduler publication, ListItemViewModel lifetime ordering, and asynchronous regression tests; an apply-ready single-range suggestion would be incomplete and unsafe.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The fix spans ListViewModel generation tracking, UI-scheduler publication, ListItemViewModel lifetime ordering, and asynchronous regression tests; an apply-ready single-range suggestion would be incomplete and unsafe.

confidence.rationale: The current upstream code performs the vulnerable pre-publication checks and completion signaling, while the converged fork fixes the race with generation checks at publication and queued completion sentinels plus deterministic tests.

### Allow the Retargets spelling used by the new tests

**Severity:** `low`

The new lifecycle test text uses the valid build term `Retargets`, but the spelling check currently reports it as unrecognized. Please add `Retargets` to `.github/actions/spell-check/allow/code.txt` so the PR's validation remains clean.
